2125991147881558275.en_summary: Elad Gil says of the hyperscaler endgame, "I don't know if that's a durable business". Discusses trillion dollar companies including Nvidia, Meta, Google, pharma, JPMorgan Chase near $1T. Mentions SpaceX shifting to hyperscaler, inflation, GDP growth, global liquidity via Internet enabling fast growth of Anthropic and OpenAI.
2125991147881558275.zh_summary: Elad Gil 表示超大規模運算商的終局「我不知道那是否是可持續的業務」。討論包括 Nvidia、Meta、Google、製藥公司在內的萬億美元公司，JPMorgan Chase 接近1萬億美元。提到 SpaceX 轉向超大規模運算商，通貨膨脹、GDP 增長、透過互聯網的全球流動性使 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 快速增長。

2125990371897557278.en_summary: Ven was one of the earliest believers that we could use our then-current model to solve millennium prize problems. There are a lot of brilliant people in the world, but being brilliant and also having correctly-placed confidence and courage to keep pushing on something that others don't think is possible is a very valuable thing and fairly rare. I am grateful so many people at OpenAI have this combination.
2125990371897557278.zh_summary: Ven 是最早相信我們可以使用當時的模型解決千年大獎問題的人之一。世界上有很多聰明的人，但既聰明又有正確放置的信心和勇氣，繼續推動他人認為不可能的事情，是非常有價值且相當罕見的。我感謝 OpenAI 有這麼多人擁有這種組合。

2125987213078941826.en_summary: Scott is a world class gem. Again, “endless demand for compute” is meaningless if the cost of capital moves against AI. It’s a fast moving metamorphosis. If you own AI equities you MUST understand these capital structures, many unrecognizable relative to 5 years ago. Quoted: Scott Goodwin of Diameter Capital explains bear case for neoclouds needing 30-40% more per gW due to higher cost of capital vs hyperscalers. Coreweave 9% bonds, SpaceX secured chip debt at 8.5%.
2125987213078941826.zh_summary: Scott 是世界級的瑰寶。再次，「對計算的無盡需求」如果資本成本對 AI 不利就毫無意義。這是快速變化的變質。如果你擁有 AI 股票，你必須了解這些資本結構，許多與5年前相比已不可辨認。引用：Diameter Capital 的 Scott Goodwin 解釋新雲端的看空理由，由於資本成本較高，每 GW 需要多賺30-40%。Coreweave 發行9%債券，SpaceX 以8.5%做有擔保芯片債務。
